reply.subject: Rent increase after renovation — information and documents needed

clauses.text: You report that the manager announced an approximately 9% rent increase at the October tenants’ meeting because of renovation work, and that no written notice has reached you.
The case file does not establish whether a formal notice has since arrived or the date it may have been received, so the deadline position cannot yet be confirmed.

The process calls for a challenge to be submitted to the conciliation authority within 30 days; please contact us promptly if you receive a written notice, and provide the notice and any envelope, delivery record or other proof showing when it arrived.
Please also send the lease contract, evidence of the current rent and its components, any prior rent adjustment, and any written reasons or calculation for the proposed increase.

Because the reported increase is attributed to renovation work, please provide any available breakdown of the work, costs and amount allocated to the rent increase; landlord correspondence about the increase could also help.
If a conciliation request has already been filed, please send a copy and confirmation showing when it was submitted.
